from docx import Document

from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.enum.section import WD_ORIENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement
import re

def new_doc():
    d=Document()
    s=d.sections[0]
    s.left_margin=s.right_margin=Inches(0.9); s.top_margin=s.bottom_margin=Inches(0.9)
    st=d.styles["Normal"]; st.font.name="Calibri"; st.font.size=Pt(10.5)
    st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"),"Calibri")
    for n,sz in (("Heading 1",14),("Heading 2",12),("Heading 3",11)):
        h=d.styles[n]; h.font.name="Calibri"; h.font.size=Pt(sz); h.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(0x1F,0x3A,0x5F)
        h.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"),"Calibri")
    return d

def runs(p,text,size=None,bold_all=False,italic=False):
    # **bold** markup
    parts=re.split(r"(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)",text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part: continue
        b = part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**")
        t = part[2:-2] if b else part
        r=p.add_run(t); r.bold = b or bold_all; r.italic=italic
        if size: r.font.size=Pt(size)
    return p

def para(d,text,size=None,italic=False,align=None,space_after=6,bold=False):
    p=d.add_paragraph(); runs(p,text,size,bold_all=bold,italic=italic)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(space_after)
    if align=="center": p.alignment=WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    return p

def bullet(d,text,level=0,size=None):
    p=d.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level==0 else "List Bullet 2")
    runs(p,text,size); p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(3)
    return p

def num(d,text,size=None):
    p=d.add_paragraph(style="List Number"); runs(p,text,size); p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(3); return p

def shade(cell,hexcolor):
    tcPr=cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr(); sh=OxmlElement("w:shd")
    sh.set(qn("w:val"),"clear"); sh.set(qn("w:color"),"auto"); sh.set(qn("w:fill"),hexcolor); tcPr.append(sh)

def table(d,rows,widths,size=8.5,header=True,first_col_bold=False):
    t=d.add_table(rows=len(rows),cols=len(rows[0])); t.style="Table Grid"; t.alignment=WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit=False

            c.paragraphs[0].text=""
            lines=str(val).split("\n")
            for k,line in enumerate(lines):
                p=c.paragraphs[0] if k==0 else c.add_paragraph()
                p.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(1)
                runs(p,line,size,bold_all=(header and i==0) or (first_col_bold and j==0))
            if header and i==0: shade(c,"D9E2F3")
    # set grid widths
    grid=t._tbl.tblGrid
    for j,gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"),str(int(widths[j]*1440)))
    d.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(2)
    return t

d.add_heading("VII. Key Legal Issues",level=1)
d.add_heading("1. Third-party releases after Purdue",level=2)
para(d,"Purdue holds that the Bankruptcy Code does not authorize a release and injunction that extinguishes claims against non-debtors without the consent of the affected claimants. The Filed Plan’s § 10.4(c) is labeled “Non-Consensual” and the DS describes it that way. That label alone gives the Committee and the U.S. Trustee a clean objection. Mechanically, § 10.4(b)–(c) operate through an opt-out. Whether silence or a failure to opt out amounts to consent is contested after Purdue, and courts are divided. Opt-out mechanics are most defensible for creditors who actually receive a ballot and vote, with conspicuous disclosure. They are least defensible for deemed-rejecting classes (Classes 5–7), which receive nothing and do not vote.")
para(d,"**Recommendation.** Concede the Committee’s point in principle. Retitle and restructure § 10.4 as a consensual release: opt-out for voting Classes 2–4 with a prominent ballot election, and opt-in or no release for non-voting classes. Keep the Debtor release (§ 10.5), which is an estate settlement under § 1123(b)(3)(A) and is not affected by Purdue, but support it with a record. para(d,"Section 503(c)(1) bars retention payments to insiders unless the court finds a bona fide job offer at the same or greater compensation, that the services are essential to the survival of the business, and that the amount is within statutory caps. The DS asserts competitor recruitment efforts and an average of 18 years of experience, but the record has no offer evidence and no insider analysis. Paying a prepetition, board-approved program in full under the Plan also raises same-treatment (§ 1123(a)(4)) and unfair-discrimination issues against 10% GUCs. **Recommendation:** remove the assumption from the Plan. Either file a § 503(c) motion supported by evidence, or move retention to a post-emergence program adopted by the New Board and disclosed under § 1129(a)(5).
